subject: Geo-specific routing & model-improvement opt-out process
messages:
From: Diane Cho <diane.cho@regiohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: RegioHealth Legal <legal@regiohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: Data residency + no-train commitment — what evidence can you provide?

Hi Monica / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier. RegioHealth has two procurement asks we need covered before we move to pilot:

1) A binding DPA amendment or clause that prohibits any use of our customer-provided content to improve or further train models (no-train).
2) Evidence that data from EU users will remain resident in EU regions and that any subprocessors with access are listed and limited to EU-domiciled vendors.

Operational details we'd like: subprocessor inventory, KMS/export controls, and an "export matrix" that shows any conditions where outputs (model responses) could cross borders or be backed up out of region. Also — do you provide audit logs showing who accessed raw prompt/response pairs (for our SOC review)?

We are on a tight timeline (procurement review ends 2026-06-04). Can you confirm what you can provide and whether Redwood can sign an explicit no-train amendment?

Best,
Diane
Director, Regulatory Affairs
RegioHealth

(Attachment: RegioHealth_requirements_20260527.pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Cho <diane.cho@regiohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Data residency + no-train commitment — what evidence can you provide?

Hi Diane — thanks for laying this out clearly. Quick summary of what we can provide and next steps: 

- Commitment: We can provide DPA language that includes a no-train clause (we've done this for other EU healthcare customers). I will route a proposed amendment to Legal for DocuSign.
- Subprocessors: We will share a current inventory (CSV) with residency tags and access scopes.
- Export matrix & backups: We'll produce a matrix showing where replicas/backups could exist and controls around export.
- Audit evidence: We can provide access logs and a sample log export showing timestamps, request IDs, and host region — we typically redact token-level secrets but provide identifying request IDs for traceability.

Questions for you: do you require KMS separation (customer-managed keys) vs. Redwood-managed keys? That will affect timelines. Also, do you need a signed commitment that model outputs will not be used for model improvement even in aggregated telemetry?

I will attach the inventory and export matrix draft once Legal signs off on the amendment wording. Karthik — can you confirm the implementation constraints for a strict no-train toggle and how it affects caching/batching? Rishi / Laura, please advise on evidence artifacts.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Sr. Manager, Privacy & Trust
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: none yet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>; Diane Cho <diane.cho@regiohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 10:33:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Data residency + no-train commitment — what evidence can you provide?

Diane / team — technical notes from infra: 

- No-train toggle: For Hosted customers we implement a request-level flag that marks data as "do-not-use-for-training". The flag prevents samples from entering model-improvement pipelines and telemetry aggregation for training. It does not change runtime caching for latency-critical prefixes — meaning short-lived KV cache entries (per-token) may still exist in memory for active sessions but are not persisted to training corpora.
- Private / Dedicated: For Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, code paths can be configured to never ship telemetry off-site; we can also provide a build that disables telemetry entirely. For Dedicated reserved pools we can enforce the same policy via routing profiles.
- Subprocessor access: We will produce a CSV of subprocessors and their access scope; EU-only subprocessors can be prioritized for the RegioHealth account and assigned to eu1 region nodes.
- Audit logs: We retain request-level logs for 13 months by default; we can provide a time-limited export and redacted request content. The logs include request ID, model variant, region, and which internal role or subprocessor serviced the request.

Impacts and tradeoffs: A strict do-not-train setting increases unit cost slightly (reduced ability to offline-optimize models based on aggregated telemetry) and may preclude certain quality improvement flows. Caching behavior: we can ensure ephemeral caches are not materialized to persisted storage.

I attach the current inventory export and an initial export_matrix_v1.xlsx for your review.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Inference
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: subprocessor_inventory_may2026.csv; export_matrix_v1.xlsx)

From: Diane Cho <diane.cho@regiohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: RegioHealth Legal <legal@regiohealth.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 15:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Data residency + no-train commitment — what evidence can you provide?

Thanks, Karthik — that helps. A few follow-ups from legal: 

1) The DPA language needs to explicitly state that Redwood will not use customer prompt/response content for model training or for deriving models or features that could be used by other customers. Aggregate telemetry that is strictly non-reidentifiable is acceptable only if explicitly called out — otherwise it must be excluded.

2) We require a subprocessor attest letter that confirms EU residence and that access is limited to support/infra roles only. The CSV is a start but not sufficient for procurement audit.

3) Export controls: in what scenarios would output be routed outside EU? We need rows in your export_matrix showing backups, failover replicas, and third-party processing (e.g., monitoring, observability vendors).

Procurement deadline is 2026-06-04. Can you provide a DocuSign amendment and the attest letters by 2026-06-02? If you can, procurement will fast-track the pilot authorization.

Best,
Diane

(Please include RFP/contract reference REG-2026-44 in responses)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Cho <diane.cho@regiohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 16:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Data residency + no-train commitment — what evidence can you provide?

Diane — thank you and understood. Action plan and deliverables: 

1) Legal amendment: Redwood Legal will prepare a DPA amendment with explicit no-train language and an exclusion for aggregate telemetry unless explicitly agreed. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/req/ABC-REGIO-2026 (we will send an editable copy by end of day tomorrow).

2) Subprocessor attestations: We will obtain written attest letters from the EU subprocessors listed in the CSV confirming their EU domicile and limited access. Delivery ETA: 2026-06-01.

3) Export matrix & backups: Updated matrix with explicit rows for failover, backups, and third-party observability will be provided by 2026-05-30.

4) Audit evidence: We will provide a sample, redacted log export (request IDs and region + servicing role) and instructions for validating in your SOC review.

Notes on technical constraints: enabling a strict no-train flag for Hosted runs in one week (config + testing). For Private deployments we can provide configuration immediately but will still collect attestations. There is a modest cost delta for the no-train commitment (I will request pricing/credit options from Sales).

Next steps: I will loop in Legal to finalize the amendment and Rishi will coordinate the attestations. Laura will post the export matrix link to the shared drive. We aim to meet your 2026-06-02/06-04 timeline.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Sr. Manager, Privacy & Trust
Redwood Inference

(Attachments: no-train-flag-impl-notes.txt; links: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/RegioHealth/privacy-pack)
